title: Bokoblin Gear
wikitext:
{{Infobox Item |image= File:BotW Boko Club Icon.png |caption= A [[Boko Club]] |pronunciation= |plural= |game= BotW |other= AoC |cost= |value= |location= |uses= {{List| * Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] * Defense }} |strength= |durability= |comp= |sample= |theme= }} The {{Term/Store|Bokoblin Gear|Bokoblin Gear|BotW, AoC, Series}} is a recurring archetype of [[Equipment]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 174}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Bokoblin Gear is a variety of equipment wielded by [[Bokoblin]]s of all types, and it occurs in three tiers of increasing strength and durability. Regular Bokoblin Gear is typically wielded by basic Bokoblins. It is formed out of [[Tree Branch]]es and bark and, due to its poor construction, has low durability and attack power.{{Cite|{{Big|Boko Club}}
A crude Bokoblin club made to clobber small prey. It's essentially a stick, so its durability is low.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Boko Bow}}
A basic Bokoblin bow made of wood. It's made by taking any tree branch and tying a string to either end, so don't expect much in the way of combat effectiveness.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Boko Shield}}
A Bokoblin-made shield created by attaching a handhold to any flat tree bark picked up off the ground. It's pretty shoddy, so don't expect it to last very long.|Inventory|BotW}} Its upgraded form, which bears the "Spiked" modifier, is most commonly found wielded by [[Blue Bokoblin]]s. It is strengthened through the use of spikes of sharpened [[Animal]] bone, giving it greater durability and damage output.{{Cite|{{Big|Spiked Boko Club}}
A reinforced Bokoblin club made to maximize damage. The sharpened bones jabbed into it make it a brutal weapon.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Spiked Boko Bat}}
After much consideration by Bokoblins on how to improve the Boko bat, they simply attached sharp spikes to it. A skilled fighter can cause immense damage with this.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Spiked Boko Spear}}
A Boko spear enhanced with sharpened animal bones. It's light, easy to use, and deals a decent amount of damage.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Spiked Boko Bow}}
An upgraded Boko Bow bound with animal bone to boost its durability and firepower. Its craftsmanship is sloppy, but it's light and easy to use.|Inventory|BotW}} The final variation, designated with the "Dragonbone" modifier, is wielded by [[Black Bokoblin]]s, [[Silver Bokoblin]]s, and [[Golden Bokoblin]]s. It is reinforced with fossilized bones, which further increases its attack power and durability beyond those of Spiked weapons.{{Cite|{{Big|Dragonbone Boko Club}}
This Bokoblin club has been reinforced with fossilized bones to maximize clobbering potential. Only the brawniest of Bokoblins can manage its immense weight.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Dragonbone Boko Bat}}
Used by only the toughest Bokoblin warriors, this Boko bat has been fortified by fossilized bone. It boasts a high durability and is strong enough to beat down powerful foes.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Dragonbone Boko Spear}}
This Boko spear has been strengthened with fossilized bones. The bones are positioned outward so the fangs bite at the opponent. Beware Bokoblins carrying this weapon.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Dragon Bone Bow}}
A Boko bow reinforced by fossils. Bokoblins handpicked the materials it's made from, so it boasts a respectable firepower.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Dragonbone Shield}}
This Boko shield is reinforced with fossilized bone. Its defensive capabilities are respectable, but its predictably slipshod craftsmanship spells low durability.|Inventory|BotW}} When scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]], the {{BotW}} Series Bokoblin [[amiibo]] will spawn a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a piece of Bokoblin Gear. All forms of Bokoblin Gear are formed around a wooden base. This means that [[Weapon]]s in this archetype will float in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and they cannot attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s or conduct [[Electricity]]. However, they will burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]], and they are unable to be manipulated through the [[Magnesis]] Rune. ====List of Equipment==== {| class="wikitable" style="width:100%; max-width:57.5em; text-align:center" |- !style="width:25%"| Item !style="width:10%"| Strength !style="width:10%"| Durability !style="width:55%"| Description |- | [[File:BotW Boko Club Icon.png|link=]]
